sources.title: Petrophysical and petrothermal dataset of the sedimentary succession in the Oliana anticline (Southern Pyrenees)
sources.read_status: PMC article full text and Tables 2–3 inspected; CC BY 4.0 stated. Published group summaries transcribed; Mendeley workbooks not obtained.
claim_notes: Only the four non-overlapping sedimentary-unit groups Core, U1, U2-3 and U4 are represented; fold-sector summaries of the same source data are excluded.
Table 2 group summaries represent plug/property values nested within parent samples; exact workbook rows and raw measurements were not audited.
Table 3 means and medians describe the same slice sets and are distinct summary statistics, not independent observations.
The article's s/± caption terminology is ambiguous; displayed spread is preserved in notes but not interpreted as a standard deviation or measurement uncertainty.
No thermal-effusivity value is derived or admitted; Mendeley attachments remain unavailable.

Four sedimentary-unit connected-porosity medians are admitted from Table 2. The article explicitly recommends the median rather than arithmetic mean for this high-CV property; the ambiguous ± s statistic and method accuracy are not encoded as median uncertainty.

Four sedimentary-unit group means for P-wave velocity and medians for Klinkenberg-corrected intrinsic gas permeability are transcribed from Table 2. P-wave means follow the article's characterization choice; permeability medians are retained with the article's high-CV representativeness warning. Mendeley raw workbooks remain unavailable and are not implied to be audited.

Four Table 3 thermal-conductivity medians for sedimentary units are admitted as separately labeled summaries of the same slice sets as the existing means. They are not additional independent observations. The article notes thermal-conductivity CV below 20% and characterizes groups with means; ambiguous ± s values are not assigned as median uncertainty. No heat-effusivity group summary was found in the inspected article tables.

provenance.method: Published Table 2 and Table 3 sedimentary-unit summaries transcribed from the audited CSVs; no raw workbook rows or graph-derived values.
